title: PyroSpectra: Biomass Burning Emission Factors From Closed-Path FTIR Time Series Spectra
description: PyroSpectra retrieves trace-gas concentrations, emission ratios and emission factors from closed-path FTIR time-series spectra of biomass-burning smoke. Version 2.0 adds an optically-thick, high-concentration retrieval (thick_smoke) for close-to-source, undiluted smoke: full-spectrum pervasive absorbers (CO2 isotopologues, H2O, CO), a per-window non-negative continuum term, non-negative bounded least squares, optical-depth channel weighting, slope-based emission ratios with an optically-thin regime, and a 3-sigma detection framework with a carbon-plausibility bound; plus a publication-quality PDF diagnostics suite (spectral-fit atlas, excess-vs-CO2 hysteresis, Tikhonov L-curve and residual spectrum). The v1.1 temporal-regularisation retrieval is retained. Implements the methodology of Richardson-Foulger, Wooster, Gomez-Dans and Grosvenor (2026), JGR: Biogeosciences.
